title: Language conventions are stack-tagged records harvested from the skills
body:
Source: .krn/runs/brain-research/north-star.md missing item 2; operator "no per-language prose skills" (memory universal-skills-dogfood); supersedes t-55bxdhj (a typescript prose skill).
Why: language conventions reach a session only as records the brain serves at the moment of need (SessionStart, first edit of a file kind, Stop, query); today the typescript skill and the boilerplate-2026 frontend/WP skills are prose nobody retrieves by scope.
Outcome: `krn standards harvest` turns the typescript skill and the six boilerplate-2026 skills into accepted records in standards/records.json, each with applies.stacks or applies.paths (node for *.ts, wordpress/frontend paths), evidence pointing at the source file:line, and no record without a scope.
Files: standards/records.json, src/brain/skill-harvest.ts, test/brain/skill-harvest.test.ts
Proof: `krn standards query --file src/a.ts "typescript"` returns a harvested node record; the edit hook (t-ctnaq2e) serves it on the first .ts edit of a session.
Predicted: outside drain == 0 in >= 3 rows
